Definition: shaggy; as noun, a he-goat; by analogy, a faun
BiblicalUsage: adj; 1) hairy; n m; 2) he-goat, buck; 2a) as sacrificial animal; 2b) satyr, may refer to a demon possessed goat like the swine of Gadara (Mt 8:30-32)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
